# Github Action: Goreleaser build

This Action wraps GoReleaser to build and optionally publish Go application releases. It supports snapshot builds, full releases, Docker images (if configured), and artifact upload for CI use.

## Inputs

- `goreleaser-config`: Path to the `.goreleaser.yml` config file. Default: `.goreleaser.yml`.
  - `.goreleaser.yml` (root config)
  - `.goreleaser.docker.yml` (alternate config for Docker‑only builds)
  - `deploy/.goreleaser.yml` (monorepo: config under `deploy/`)
- `snapshot`: `"true"` to build a snapshot (no release/publish). Typical for non‑release branches. Default: `"false"`.
- `clean`: `"true"` to remove the dist directory before building. Default: `"true"`.
- `skip-validate`: `"true"` to skip GoReleaser validation checks. Default: `"false"`.
- `skip-publish`: `"true"` to build artifacts but not publish them (build‑only). Default: `"false"`.
- `goreleaser-version`: GoReleaser CLI version to use. Default: `"latest"`.
  - Find the latest GoReleaser version on [their Github](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/releases/latest)
- `go-version`: Go toolchain version to install with `actions/setup-go`. Default: `"1.25.6"`.
  - See the latest version at [https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text](https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text)
- `working-directory`: Directory in which GoReleaser should run (where `.goreleaser.yml` and `go.mod` live). Default: ".".
  - `"."` when the Go module and `.goreleaser.yml` are at the repo root
  - `"apps/api"` for a monorepo app under `apps/api`
  - `"cmd/cli"` for a dedicated CLI module living under `cmd/cli`
- `docker-build`: `"true"` to enable Docker/QEMU/Buildx setup for Docker images configured in `.goreleaser.yml`. Default: `"false"`.
- `extra-args`: Additional arguments appended to the GoReleaser command, space‑separated. Default: empty string.
  - `--skip=announce` to skip announcement hooks
  - `--parallelism=2` to limit concurrency on busy runners
  - `--timeout=60m` for very large multi‑platform builds
  - `--skip=sbom` `--skip=changelog` to temporarily turn off specific GoReleaser steps (multiple args with spaces)
- `dry-run`: `"true"` to perform a dry run (validate and show what would happen). Default: `"false"`.
- `release-notes`: Optional path to a release notes file passed via `--release-notes`. Default: empty string.
  - `CHANGELOG.md` (use top section of your changelog if configured that way)
  - `.github/release_notes/v1.2.3.md` (pre‑generated notes per tag)
  - `build/release-notes.txt` (a file generated by a previous step in the workflow)
- `artifact-name`: Name for uploaded artifacts. If not set, default is `<repo-name>-dist` or `<repo-name>-snapshot-dist` when snapshot == `"true"`.
  - `api-dist` for a single API service
  - `myapp-snapshot-dist` for snapshot builds
  - `cli-artifacts` when the repo contains a CLI and you want a more explicit artifact name
- `github-token`: Token used by GoReleaser for GitHub operations. If not set, falls back to `github.token` provided by Actions.

## Usage

- Snapshot build (no publish), upload artifacts for inspection:

  ```yaml
  ---
  name: GoReleaser Snapshot

  on:
  workflow_dispatch:

  jobs:
  goreleaser:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
      - name: Run GoReleaser snapshot build
          uses: redjax/PipelineTemplates/.github/actions/goreleaser-build@gh/goreleaser-build/v0.0.1
          with:
          goreleaser-config: .goreleaser.yml
          snapshot: "true"
          clean: "true"
          skip-validate: "false"
          skip-publish: "true"
          goreleaser-version: "latest"
          go-version: "1.25.6"
          working-directory: "."
          docker-build: "false"
          extra-args: ""
          dry-run: "false"
          release-notes: ""
          artifact-name: ""
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  ```

- Full release on tag, publishing to GitHub Releases:
  
  ```yaml
  ---
  name: GoReleaser Release

  on:
    push:
      tags:
        - "v*.*.*"

  jobs:
    goreleaser:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - name: Run GoReleaser release
          uses: redjax/PipelineTemplates/.github/actions/goreleaser-build@gh/goreleaser-build/v0.0.1
          with:
            goreleaser-config: .goreleaser.yml
            snapshot: "false"
            clean: "true"
            skip-validate: "false"
            skip-publish: "false"
            goreleaser-version: "latest"
            go-version: "1.25.6"
            working-directory: "."
            docker-build: "true"
            extra-args: ""
            dry-run: "false"
            release-notes: ""
            artifact-name: ""
            github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  ```
